title: Bee Removal Long Island City Queens
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Long Island City, Queens. Wall void nests treated and removed. NYS DEC-licensed.
intro: Long Island City residents and business owners facing wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nests need fast, professional treatment to protect their properties and families. Our experienced specialists serve all of Long Island City, from the waterfront high-rises to Court Square and Dutch Kicks neighborhoods. We identify the species, treat active nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, and galleries, remove accessible nest material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has been serving Long Island City for years with a Best Pest Control NYC technician — licensed by the NYS DEC or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator — who understands the unique challenges of bee removal in Queens' urban environment. We offer same-day service, use eco-friendly methods that preserve bee populations when possible.
localContext: Long Island City's mix of historic rowhouses, modern residential towers, and converted industrial buildings creates diverse environments where wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets commonly nest in wall voids, rooftops, and HVAC systems. Carpenter bees bore into exposed wood trim and eaves. From Hunters Point South to Queensbridge, our team navigates the neighborhood efficiently to provide prompt nest treatment and removal services tailored to your specific property type.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Long Island City?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Long Island City?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Long Island City property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency nest removal services throughout Long Island City. Most residential treatments are completed within 2–4 hours, though larger nests or difficult-to-access locations may require additional time or follow-up visits.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets return after removal?
faqs.answer: Our comprehensive service includes treating the nest, removing accessible material, and sealing every entry point to prevent recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
